tools.name: finance_search
tools.description:
Search financial data and return an answer with an inline widget.

    Covers stocks, macro, forex, crypto, commodities, earnings, technicals,
    and related market questions. Pass the user's question in `query` without
    rephrasing.

    To screen a named watchlist or portfolio, call list_watchl

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description: List the authenticated user's watchlists and their symbols.

tools.name: create_watchlist
tools.description:
Create a watchlist with the given name and ticker symbols.

    Args:
        name: Watchlist name
        symbols: List of stock symbols (e.g. ["AAPL", "MSFT"])

tools.name: update_watchlist
tools.description:
Update a watchlist's name and/or symbols.

    Args:
        watchlist_id: The watchlist UUID
        name: New name (optional)
        symbols: Updated list of symbols (optional)

tools.name: list_portfolios
tools.description: List the authenticated user's portfolios.

tools.name: create_portfolio
tools.description:
Create a portfolio with a name and base currency.

    Args:
        name: Portfolio name
        currency: Base currency (default USD)

tools.name: add_transaction
tools.description:
Add a buy, sell, deposit, or withdrawal transaction to a portfolio.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID
        symbol: Stock symbol (e.g. "AAPL"). For deposit/withdrawal use "$CASH"
            (aliases "CASH" / blank are normalized to "$CASH").
        side: "buy", "sell", "deposit

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description:
Get current holdings with quantity, cost basis, market value, and unrealized P&L.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID

tools.name: get_portfolio_statistics
tools.description:
Get portfolio performance statistics (returns, allocation, risk).

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List active price and event alerts for the authenticated user.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description:
Create a price or event alert for a symbol.

    Args:
        symbol: Stock symbol (e.g. "AAPL")
        alert_type: "target_price", "movement_pct", or "event"
        direction: Required for price alerts — "above", "below", or "either"
        threshold: Required for price alerts — price level or

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Get recent triggered alert notifications.

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description:
Delete an alert by ID.

    Args:
        alert_id: The alert UUID

tools.name: list_library_folders
tools.description: List folders in the authenticated user's research library.

tools.name: create_library_folder
tools.description:
Create a library folder, optionally nested under a parent.

    Args:
        name: Folder name
        parent_id: Parent folder UUID (optional — omit for a root folder)

tools.name: rename_library_folder
tools.description:
Rename a library folder.

    Args:
        folder_id: The folder UUID
        name: New folder name

tools.name: move_library_folder
tools.description:
Move a library folder under a different parent (or to root).

    Args:
        folder_id: The folder UUID to move
        parent_id: New parent folder UUID (omit / null for library root)

tools.name: delete_library_folder
tools.description:
Delete a library folder and everything inside it.

    Args:
        folder_id: The folder UUID

tools.name: list_library_items
tools.description:
List documents in a library folder, or at the root if no folder is given.

    Args:
        folder_id: Folder UUID to list (optional — omit for root-level items)

tools.name: get_library_item
tools.description:
Get a library document's metadata and content.

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID

tools.name: create_library_item
tools.description:
Create a new markdown document in the research library.

    Args:
        title: Document title
        content: Markdown body
        folder_id: Folder UUID (optional — omit for library root)

tools.name: update_library_item
tools.description:
Update a library document's title and/or content (content edits create a new version).

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID
        title: New title (optional)
        content: New markdown body (optional)

tools.name: move_library_item
tools.description:
Move a library document into a different folder (or to root).

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID to move
        folder_id: Destination folder UUID (omit / null for library root)

tools.name: delete_library_item
tools.description:
Delete a library document and all of its stored versions.

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID

tools.name: list_library_item_versions
tools.description:
List version history for a library document (newest first).

    Args:
        item_id: The item UUID

tools.name: search_library
tools.description:
Full-text search across the authenticated user's library documents.

    Args:
        query: Search terms
        limit: Max results (default 20, capped at 50)

tools.name: list_journal
tools.description:
List generated daily research journal entries (most recent first).

    Entries appear only after the automatic end-of-day journal generation run.
    Drafts from submit_journal_draft are not listed until that run completes.

tools.name: get_journal_entry
tools.description:
Get a full generated journal entry by ID from list_journal.

    Draft ids from submit_journal_draft are not readable until end-of-day
    generation; use list_journal after the daily run for valid entry ids
    (integer or legacy UUID).

    Args:
        entry_id: Journal entry id from list_journa

tools.name: submit_journal_draft
tools.description:
Submit a journal draft for a day. Same-day resubmissions are retained as separate drafts.

    The draft is accepted immediately but the readable daily journal entry is
    generated automatically at end of day; it then appears in list_journal.
    The returned draft id is not a list_journal / get_j

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "finance_search" is 1118 chars, far longer than this server's median (165). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_notifications · Private data: list_library_items, get_library_item, create_library_item, update_library_item, move_library_item, delete_library_item, list_library_item_versions, search_library · Public sink: add_transaction, submit_journal_draft · Destructive: delete_alert, delete_library_folder, delete_library_item, list_journal, get_journal_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_notifications · Private data: list_library_items, get_library_item, create_library_item, update_library_item, move_library_item, delete_library_item, list_library_item_versions, search_library · Public sink: add_transaction, submit_journal_draft · Destructive: delete_alert, delete_library_folder, delete_library_item, list_journal, get_journal_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
